program: Spin-off A v2m: out-of-sample device confirmation of the inversion-covariance witness (scale-aware gates) on ibm_marrakesh
relation_to_prior: Identical design, conditions, and frozen analysis to PREREGISTRATION_witness_v2.json (sha 428e09d2..., passed 8/8 on ibm_fez, job dbg9o45jm0ks73eg6cfg). This run answers the severity critique recorded in notes/adversarial-review-paper2.md (referee finding 6): the v2 pass was on the same device as one threshold-calibration run. This run is on the other device and on fresh data. Honest severity accounting, stated in advance: marrakesh's v1 dataset also informed the K_I window (its K_I was 0.280, inside the window), so the window itself is not device-out-of-sample; what this run genuinely risks is (a) the tracking condition C4, which marrakesh v1 passed by a statistically unresolved margin (dr = +0.0009 +/- 0.0012, bootstrap P(dr>0) = 0.75 -- luck, as the paper now states), (b) the coherent conditions C5/C7 on a second device under the new gates, (c) K_I drifting outside [0.155, 0.355] under a new calibration era, and (d) all sanity conditions. A pass does not upgrade the window's provenance; it tests cross-device reproducibility of all eight conditions on fresh data.
experiment: Four arms, ONE job, ibm_marrakesh, layout [53,54,55], seed_transpiler 42, 20k shot-equivalents/input, 36 pubs, ~480k shots (~132 QPU-seconds per the v1 marrakesh job record). Runner hardware/run_witness.py (unmodified, as in v1). Output stored as data/witness_counts_v2_marrakesh.json (the move is outside the runner, preserving the v1 dataset).
analysis_script: hardware/analyze_witness_v2.py, frozen since registration 428e09d2 (unmodified; gates embedded there must match)

decision_criteria.confirmed: ALL of (conditions C1-C8 as numbered in the manuscript): 16/16 cells all arms; VE_B >= 0.90; VE_C1 >= VE_B - 0.02; r(D_C1, D_th(C')) > r(D_C1, D_th(C)); R_C2 >= 2; K_C2 >= 0.8; |K_I - 0.255| <= 0.10; K_I <= 0.5 (backstop, implied by the window)
decision_criteria.not_confirmed: any condition missed - report prominently, no reinterpretation; all prior verdicts remain reported in full either way

pre_submission_health_check: Submit only if, at submission time, IBM's published calibration for the pinned layout satisfies: readout assignment error <= 0.03 on each of qubits 53/54/55 AND two-qubit gate error <= 0.01 on pairs (53,54) and (54,55). Values at registration: see calibration_at_registration. If the check fails, do not submit; re-check on later calibration cycles. Decided before any data exist.
calibration_at_registration: 2026-10-27: readout q53 0.0028, q54 0.0074, q55 0.0162; cz(53,54) 0.0014, cz(54,55) 0.0013 -- all within thresholds. The backend is presently in maintenance; submission therefore WAITS until it returns to active status and the health rule is re-evaluated on the then-current published calibration, so the job cannot execute under an unchecked post-maintenance calibration. This waiting rule is part of the registration.
budget_note: ~132 QPU-seconds; 210 s remain in the current Open-plan window before this run.
timestamp_note: Pushed to the PUBLIC repository (github.com/andrewmatlock/postselected-work-statistics) BEFORE submission, as with all registrations since spin-off A began.
no_post_hoc_changes: Any deviation from this plan is exploratory and must be labelled so.
